name: @veryl/canon-browser-proof
description: Browser proof for Veryl Canon: starts the real server, drives the shipped client in Chromium, and asserts on what a person actually sees.

scripts.//pretest: The proof drives the BUILT server (dist/server/src/index.js). Building it here means `npm test` can never run against a stale build, which is the one way a proof like this can be quietly wrong.
